Anya: quick heads-up — surgical hotpatch ready for stable-2026-03, cherrypicked PR 8347 into `release/stable-2026-03` — cutover window opens in 35m, we need 2 approvers + DB admin ok before merge. PR: https://git.company.com/redwood/inference/pull/8347 :clock1:
Mike: on it, I'll do a review pass now, focusing on the runtime config changes. :eyes:
Ravi-DBA: pinged — need to confirm the small schema migration is no-op for replicas. can you paste the `ALTER` snippet?
Anya: snippet below:
```
ALTER TABLE request_logs ADD COLUMN shard_key varchar(32) DEFAULT '';
-- backfilled in migration job, no lock expected
```
Anya: migration applied in staging and backfill job finished, but want rdbms team signoff before we touch prod.
Jen: I'm available to second-review, but need smoke results from canary. can we run smoke job now?
Sam: kicked off smoke: CI job `smoke/release-stable-2026-03` started — link: https://ci.company.com/job/8347-smoke, ETA ~6m. sre-bot: smoke job queued — will post status.
sre-bot: smoke job passed (all checks green) — 6m 12s. :white_check_mark:
Mike: reviewed, left one tiny comment about a log message, non-blocking. LGTM after that fix. :+1:
Ravi-DBA: checked migration plan and replica lag metrics, looks safe. DB admin OK. :ok_hand:
Jen: I verified smoke and the canary trace looks normal. Gave LGTM.
Anya: we have DB admin OK + Jen LGTM + Mike LGTM (pending tiny nitfix but ok to merge). final call — merging in 5m unless anyone objects.
Sam: staging rollout observed no errors for 10m, go for merge. :rocket:
DevOps: tagging release and starting merge at T+2m.
Anya: merged and created release `stable-2026-03-hotfix-8347` — triggering deploy orchestration. Thanks all. :tada:
